page_title: OSA 2-0 LEV | Osasuna v Levante 08/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' A lofted pass picks out Jose Morales (Levante) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
90+2' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathew Ryan, who smothers the ball.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
87' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
83' The attendance for today's match is 18160.
82' Today's match ends for Ivan Romero who will be replaced by Goduine Koyalipou (Levante).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jose Morales will replace Unai Vencedor (Levante).
77' It is time for a substitution. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) is on for Jorge Cabello.
77' Alvaro Del Moral prepares a substitution. Etta Eyong is replaced by Victor Garcia (Levante).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Aimar Oroz cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Victor Munoz leaves the pitch and Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) comes on.
73' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
71' Iker Munoz (Osasuna) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ante Budimir.
69' Alessio Lisci decides to make a substitution. Inigo Arguibide will be replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
69' The substitution is prepared. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruben Garcia.
69' Etta Eyong (Levante) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
62' Here is a change. Roger Brugue (Levante) is going off and Alvaro Del Moral gives the last tactical orders to Iker Losada.
58' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Jorge Cabello (Levante) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
57' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Guzman had an easy-decision to make.
57' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
53' The resulting set piece from Levante is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' Problems for Alessio Lisci as Lucas Torro is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Iker Munoz (Osasuna) replaces him.
50' Close! Victor Munoz (Osasuna) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
50' Great save! Victor Munoz (Osasuna) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Mathew Ryan.
48' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Guzman blows for a foul.
47' Etta Eyong (Levante) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Jose Guzman blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
40' Levante fail to score from a corner as Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) leaps to collect the ball.
36' 2 - 0 Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Mathew Ryan. 2:0.
35' Unai Vencedor (Levante) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
33' Etta Eyong (Levante) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
30' Levante can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

30' Ivan Romero (Levante) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera is equal to it and makes an easy save. The referee points to the corner flag and Levante will take a corner.
26' Great teamplay by Levante as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
24' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
24' A cross into the box from Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna) is cleared.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kervin Arriaga (Levante) was quite harsh and Jose Guzman didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
22' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
21' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) picks up an injury.

19' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Sergio Herrera was alert and the score remains the same. Corner kick. Levante will have an opportunity.
18' Kervin Arriaga (Levante) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
15' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to Lucas Torro (Osasuna) for his blatant foul.
15' Unai Vencedor (Levante) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Ruben Garcia gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Victor Munoz (Osasuna) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
10' Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathew Ryan intercepts the ball.
6' Inigo Arguibide (Osasuna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
6' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
5' Osasuna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jose Guzman.
